description: Use this when the user asks to compare or rank countries on one statistic, such as "compare GDP per capita for Germany, France and Italy" or "rank the Nordic countries by life expectancy". Pass 2 to 6 countries (names or ISO codes), the indicator, and optionally a year and an order. Returns the countries ranked with each value and year, any country without data, the source and the date it was last updated. Expand a group such as Nordic or G7 into its countries first; groups themselves are not accepted.

countries.description: Between 2 and 6 countries; a country named twice counts once

items.description: A country name or ISO code, such as "Vietnam", "VN" or "VNM"

indicator.description: population, gdp, gdp_per_capita, gdp_growth, inflation, unemployment, life_expectancy and the other listed series

order.description: desc ranks the highest value first (default), asc the lowest first

year.description: A specific calendar year; leave out for the latest year with data

name: compare_countries
title: Compare countries
